title: Indiscriminate

inlines.v: INDISCRIM'INATE, adjective [Latin indiscriminatus. See Discriminate.] 1. Undistinguishing; not making any distinction; as the indiscriminate voraciousness of a glutton. 2. Not having discrimination; confused. 3. Undistinguished or undistinguishable.
